            c1 = max(x for y, x in comp)
            if r1 - r0 < 2 or c1 - c0 < 2:
                continue
            border = ({(r0, x) for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)} |
                      {(r1, x) for x in range(c0, c1 + 1)} |
                      {(y, c0) for y in range(r0, r1 + 1)} |
                      {(y, c1) for y in range(r0, r1 + 1)})
            if set(comp) != border:
                continue
            fill = 7 if ((r1-r0-1) * (c1-c0-1)) % 2 else 2
            for y in range(r0 + 1, r1):
                for x in range(c0 + 1, c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
